messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **official Canadian public holidays that automatically create a long‑weekend in 2023** (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday).  
For each holiday I’ve included the date it fell on in 2023 and the three‑day stretch that constitutes the long weekend.

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| **Good Friday** | Friday, April 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| **Family Day (Ontario)** | Monday, Feb 20 | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • Some holidays that fall on a Saturday or Sunday (e.g., Canada Day on Saturday Jul 1, Remembrance Day on Saturday Nov 11) do not automatically create a long weekend. If you take the following Monday off, you can still enjoy a four‑day break.  
> • Provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day in British Columbia, Saskatchewan, etc.) may differ in date; the table above reflects the federal holidays that create long weekends nationwide.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use the dates as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
